description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read the portfolio's data-quality warnings — what the import could not read, what it assumed, and what could not be priced — instead of the whole context. Each item carries the engine's own sentence verbatim plus its kind, the `account` that raised it and the symbols it names. kind filters to one of: parse, unpriced, fx, delisted, openingCash, shortCredit, openingBalance, writeOff, skippedRows, exportWindow, missingHistory, other. symbol filters to the warnings naming that holding. byKind counts the FULL list, not the filtered page, so one call shows what else exists. Paginate with limit/offset and nextOffset. These are import and valuation caveats, never investment advice.
name: warnings
title: Warnings
